slides.texte_overlay:
Rules for being the neighbor
everyone trusts

1. Say hello every time

Names matter.
Learn theirs.

2. Keep the noise down
after 10 p.m.

Thin walls, thick respect.

3. Lend your tools

And don't ask twice
for them back.

4. Help when it snows

Clear their path too.
Ten extra minutes.

5. Know a little about
your area

Its history, its stories.
Good neighbors are curious.
slides.texte_sophia:
5. Know a little about
your area

Use a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.
